title: The Long Hill
synopsis: At the top of Long Hill the valley lights go out, and the Hush starts to climb toward the train. There is no way round. Only down.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: Top of Long Hill. Hold the bar!
The valley lights... they're going out.
It's down there. Right by our line.
It's coming up the hill. It hears us.
No light. No sound. We just roll.
Oh no. The old crossing bell!
It saw us. It's coming down!
Faster! The town is just ahead!
It will be back. Hold the bar.
